cycles.name: Every-morning gap-up short
cycles.plain: Short the 2 biggest no-news gap-ups every morning. Fresh 10-year test, harsh costs: 2699 trades, +0.28% a trade, but a 0.5% worse entry turns it negative and only 7 of 11 years were positive. Real but thin: it needs fills at the official open.

cycles.name: Euphoria short (mirror of panic buy)
cycles.plain: On mornings NIFTY opens 0.3%+ up, short the 2 biggest no-news gap-ups: +0.98% a trade over 10 years (1,527 trades, 10 of 11 years positive). But ordinary mornings did just as well (+0.98%), so the euphoria condition is not the edge. Led to H37 (every-morning gap-up short).

cycles.name: Volume-climax gap fade, short
cycles.plain: Fresh test 2015-2020: 982 trades, about ₹0 after charges (+₹143 total), win 52%. Failed; the sealed year is kept for a strategy that passes.

cycles.name: Learn after every session (3 sessions)
cycles.plain: Three random weeks in date order, retraining and reviewing every trade after each: +₹421, +₹61, +₹256 (11 of 18 trades won). Learned: drop the profit target (session 2), lower the confidence bar to 3x (session 3). Shorting run-up stocks won most; buying into a falling market lost most, but a "trade with the market only" rule earned less over the past year, so it was rejected.
